rubric.gasLow: Optimistic estimate (shortest path, no revert retries, minimal contract interaction)
rubric.gasHigh: Conservative estimate (multi-hop, state updates, possible revert retries)
rubric.flashLoanNeeded: Whether this pattern typically requires flash loan capital amplification

OD-01.rationale: getReserves() manipulation: flash loan→single-pool large swap→read reserves→exploit→repay.

OD-02.rationale: TWAP window manipulation requires multiple blocks/txs to sustain feed distortion.

OD-04.rationale: Stale oracle exploitation—just call protocol function when oracle is stale.

OD-05.rationale: Heartbeat failure exploitation—wait for oracle downtime then one tx.

LR-01.rationale: Mint/burn at manipulated instant reserves—flash swap skews pool ratio.

LR-02.rationale: Liquidation manipulation: longest single-attack chain (flash loan→distort→liquidate→profit→repay).

LR-03.rationale: TVL/volume inflation: flash deposit→claim reward→withdraw. Short flow.

TO-01.rationale: Missing deadline MEV: hold victim tx in mempool, single tx when profitable.

TO-02.rationale: Sandwich attack: front-run + back-run two txs. MEV bundle.

TO-03.rationale: Reentrancy price manipulation: re-enter during callback, drain via multiple iterations.

AC-01.rationale: Oracle address takeover: one setter call. Lowest gas in library.

AC-02.rationale: Economic parameter adjustment: one setter call.

AC-03.rationale: Unlimited mint: one mint call then dump tokens on DEX.

CL-01.rationale: Precision rounding: hundreds of repeated micro-tx to accumulate rounding gains.

CL-02.rationale: Decimal mismatch: deposit incorrectly-scaled token in one or two txs.

CL-03.rationale: AMM curve parameter exploit: complex math, large swap, curve region push.

CR-01.rationale: Sole external price source: manipulate external DEX/oracle + exploit target protocol.

CR-02.rationale: LP token collateral valuation: manipulate underlying pool + deposit LP tokens as collateral.

CR-03.rationale: Unchecked cross-protocol call: call external contract without return check.

CR-04.rationale: Cross-protocol cascading manipulation: deepest call graph (depth >= 2), multi-protocol, multi-hop.
